$comment: LLM routes this project may use. §58 constraint (2026-10-08): the pipeline must run at zero cost, so every preset here is marked free/non-free explicitly and LLM_FREE_ONLY=true refuses anything not free. Limits are the provider's published free-tier numbers at the time of writing — they change; verify before relying on them.

presets.label: Google AI Studio (Gemini free tier)
presets.freeLimits: Flash / Flash-Lite only on the free tier (Pro is not free). Measured 2026-10-08: a 14,024-token prompt with max_tokens 3,000 completed in 1.2 s (gemini-flash-lite-latest) / 2.1 s (gemini-3.5-flash) — the specification call that cannot fit Groq's 8,000 TPM is fine here.
presets.caveats: Keys are AI Studio keys (`AQ.…` and legacy `AIza…` both work as Bearer tokens). `gemini-2.5-*` is retired for new keys (404 → use 3.x). During the 2026-10-08 probe gemini-3.6-flash / gemini-3.7-flash returned 503 or timed out and gemini-flash-latest 503'd; gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-flash-lite-latest were reliable — keep the Lite alias as the fallback route (`LLM_MODEL=gemini-flash-lite-latest`). On the free tier Google may use prompts to improve its products; never send real client secrets.
presets.source: ai.google.dev rate limits + AI Studio (see docs/19 §6) + live probe 2026-10-08 (probe log in PHASE_REPORTS/evidence/phase4-provider-probe.txt)

presets.label: Groq free plan
presets.freeLimits: Free plan sample: 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD, 8,000 TPM, 200,000 tokens/day per organisation.
presets.caveats: Limits apply per organisation, not per key. Fastest of the free options.

presets.label: OpenRouter :free models
presets.freeLimits: 20 RPM and 50 requests/day per account without a top-up. Measured 2026-10-08: nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free answered a JSON-mode call in 1.7 s, cohere/north-mini-code:free in 0.7 s; google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free was rate-limited upstream and thinkingmachines/inkling-small:free refused non-agentic clients (403).
presets.caveats: The free roster rotates (16 `:free` slugs on 2026-10-08) — re-check `GET /api/v1/models` (pricing.prompt = 0) before relying on a slug; `deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1:free` had already become paid-only. Used here as a fallback route, not the default.

presets.label: Local model (Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp)
presets.freeLimits: Unlimited; bounded only by the machine (≈ the model file size in RAM, CPU-only is usable at 16 GB with a 4B Q4 model).
presets.caveats: No network, no data leaves the machine — the best option for real client data. Slower and weaker than hosted free tiers.

presets.label: Scripted client persona (dev/CI/demo)
presets.caveats: Not an AI: the deterministic persona of packages/testing. Used by tests and demos (D-025).

presets.label: No LLM configured
presets.caveats: Agent jobs fail fast with REQUIREMENTS_AGENT_NOT_CONFIGURED / SPEC_AGENT_NOT_CONFIGURED instead of pretending.

presets.label: OpenAI (paid)
presets.caveats: Blocked while LLM_FREE_ONLY=true. Enabling it needs an explicit LLM_FREE_ONLY=false and a budget decision.

presets.label: Anthropic (paid)
presets.caveats: Blocked while LLM_FREE_ONLY=true. Phase 4 requires the Spec Auditor on a *different* provider — a free second route is needed there.
